## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you're facing.

**Example**: I'm frustrated when I cannot [...]
**Example**: It's difficult to [...]

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include how this would work from a user's perspective.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the scenario where this feature would be used. Be specific about your workflow and how this feature improves it.

## Implementation Ideas (optional)

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here. This could include API design, configuration options, or architectural approaches.

## Additional Context

- Links to similar features in other tools or projects.
- Screenshots or mockups, if applicable.
- Any relevant prior discussion or issues.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to confirm this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have described the problem clearly, not just my preferred solution
